messages:
alex.cheng: noticed console dashboard counts dropped after the new route header landed in canary. SDKs are sending 'X-Route-Proto: compact-v2' and our console parser is collapsing it to 'compact' which breaks a few saved widgets. anyone look into this?
priya: compact-v2 was intended to be backwards compatible. SDKs should probably normalize before sending. we tried to keep the header small but not at the cost of observability.
jamie: console side change is easy (accept -v2 suffix), but saved dashboards/alerts expect the old tag name. if we change parsing now we risk noisy alert churn.
chen: quick check: staging logs show X-Route-Proto=compact-v2 and route_meta parsed as 'compact' (suffix stripped). parser code currently splits on /[-_]/ and takes token0. that's the culprit.
alex.cheng: options: 1) SDK compatibility shim (emit normalized Route-Meta: compact in addition to compact-v2) 2) console dry-run that logs both parsed and raw tag then later flip 3) make console tolerate suffix but keep canonicalized tag in dashboards.
priya: prefer SDK shim for minimal console churn. we can add env opt-in like REDWOOD_ROUTE_COMPAT=1, land in py/ts quickly, follow up in go.
jamie: I'll implement a telemetry dry-run: console will parse both ways and emit telemetry events showing mapping diffs for 72h. no dashboard change until we confirm stability.
chen: sample shim idea in py client: headers = { 'X-Route-Proto':'compact-v2', 'Route-Meta':'compact-v2', 'Route-Meta-Normalized':'compact' } with env gate. include integration test hitting staging console.
priya: sounds good. please add changelog note about the shim and that full normalization will follow post-rollout.
ajamie: rollout plan: 1) SDK opt-in shim in canary 2) console dry-run telemetry for 72h 3) analyze telemetry and alert owners 4) flip console to accept suffix and migrate dashboards to canonical tag 5) remove shim.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging dry-run parser deployed at 2024-06-02T09:22Z :rocket:
chen: I'll open py & ts PRs today and include integration tests against the staging dry-run endpoint, tagging you both.
priya: also add a tiny e2e that ensures old dashboards don't change when both headers present. we want to avoid surprise metric drops.
alex.cheng: thanks all. once PRs are up ping here and we'll coordinate canary windows. :thumbsup:
